title: Full Auto: outside-file edits and specialist stops

steps.path: Full Auto → edit a file outside the working folder
steps.headline: Outside edits now explain the stop and offer a session-only choice.
steps.changed: The generic Yes/No becomes an explained stop. The default is Edit once; a separate choice confirms session-wide outside edits.
steps.notice: Deny replaces Skip it. Specialist stops explain themselves; the outside-edit grant never covers specialists.
